name: 서리 늑대
creator: colorsocks
design: a small stocky white-and-pale-blue frost wolf facing RIGHT. A short compact torso, chunky pointed muzzle, triangular ears, one tiny round dark eye, one pale-blue chest tuft made of only two broad points, a short curved tail on LEFT. Exactly FOUR short sturdy legs: two front below shoulders and two rear below hips, near and far pairs naturally overlapping. Small rounded paws, no toes drawn. Far legs use the muted blue spot color for separation. Minimal four-color ordinary enemy, no fur strokes, no detailed muscles, no icy crystals, no extra jewelry or glow. Same simplicity and outline weight as the boar style reference but clearly a wolf.
